title: Anganwadi Worker (Anganwadi Karyakatri)
summary: ICDS Ghazipur invites online applications from female candidates for 174 Anganwadi Worker (Anganwadi Karyakatri) vacancies across various rural and urban projects in Ghazipur district. Selection is based on merit in educational qualifications without any written exam or interview. Eligible candidates can apply online through the official portal before the deadline.
eligibility_bullets: Only female candidates are eligible to apply.
Minimum educational qualification is Intermediate (12th Pass) or equivalent from a recognized board.
Applicant must be a permanent resident of the concerned ward or gram sabha of the respective project area.
Age of the applicant must be between 18 and 35 years as of July 1, 2026.
how_to_apply_steps: Visit the official website at http://upanganwadibharti.in.
Read the recruitment guidelines and instructions carefully before applying online.
Fill out the online application form with accurate personal and educational details.
Upload scanned copies of required self-attested documents and certificates as specified.
Submit the final application form online and keep a printout for future reference.
